**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/22 (Mon) 18:57  
[USER] User inquired about common habits or practices that can cause hair damage and how to avoid them.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Overuse of heating tools can cause hair damage; advisable to let hair air dry and use heating tools occasionally with heat protectant.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Excessive use of hair products like dyes, sprays, gels, and mousses can damage hair; advisable to use sparingly or choose natural products.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tight hairstyles can damage hair; advisable to choose looser hairstyles and avoid wearing them too frequently.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Shampooing too often can strip hair of natural oils; advisable to limit washes to twice a week and use sulfate-free shampoo.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Brushing wet hair can lead to breakage; advisable to use a wide-toothed comb or detangle while damp.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sleeping with tight hairstyles can lead to hair breakage; advisable to wear loose hairstyles to bed and use a silk scarf or pillowcase.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Not trimming split ends can cause hair breakage; advisable to trim hair regularly, generally once every three months.  
[USER] User expressed surprise about shampooing too often being bad for hair and asked for suggestions on natural hair products.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested natural hair products include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Coconut oil: Nourishes and moisturizes hair; can be used as a hair mask or on ends to prevent breakage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Apple cider vinegar: Used as a natural hair conditioner; dilute with water and use after shampooing for detangling and shine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Aloe vera gel: Soothes itchy scalp and promotes hair growth; apply to scalp and hair, leave for 30 minutes before rinsing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Argan oil: Moisturizes hair and improves elasticity; apply to hair ends or use as a leave-in conditioner.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Shea butter: Prevents hair breakage and damage; can be used as a hair mask or on ends.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised to do a patch test on a small area of skin before applying any natural hair product to avoid allergic reactions.  
[USER] User expressed enthusiasm about natural hair products and mentioned they have heard great things about coconut oil and will try it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Confirmed that coconut oil is a great option for nourishing and moisturizing hair; advised to use it spar
